events.title: Ex-Mars CEO named Lipton chair
events.body: Grant Reid joins the hot-drinks group, which hired a new CEO in October.

events.title: Goldman Strategist Sees European Earnings Pared by Weak Demand
events.body: (Bloomberg) -- European companies are set to see earnings growth of only a “few percent” in the first quarter, according to Goldman Sachs Group Inc.’s senior European strategist, substantially weaker than double-digit expansion in the US.Mo
